## cilium-dbg cni-uninstall

Remove the active Cilium CNI configurations from the host

### Synopsis

Remove the active Cilium CNI configuration files from the CNI
configuration directory on the host, so that no Pods are scheduled on the
node while the Cilium agent is down.

This is intended to be run from the `preStop` hook of the cilium-agent
DaemonSet (which is only rendered when the cni.uninstall option is
enabled), in order to remove the CNI configuration before the agent
stops.

The removal is skipped entirely when the CNI configuration is managed
externally (`custom-cni-conf`). Configs belonging to other CNI
implementations have already been renamed to `*.cilium_bak` during agent
startup.

```
cilium-dbg cni-uninstall [flags]
```

### Options

```
      --cni-conf-dir string            CNI configuration directory on the host (default: $CNI_CONF_DIR or $HOST_PREFIX/etc/cni/net.d, where HOST_PREFIX defaults to /host)
      --custom-cni-conf[=true|false]   Skip removal when the CNI configuration is managed externally (default: $CILIUM_CUSTOM_CNI_CONF or false)
  -h, --help[=true|false]              help for cni-uninstall
```
